description: This PHP source file defines the class BeanJsonSerializer, which serializes SugarBean objects into JSON format, either as a pretty-printed string or as a standardized associative array. It includes methods for converting bean objects, managing nested structures, and handling various metadata fields.

classes.name: BeanJsonSerializer
classes.description: A class that serializes SugarBean objects into JSON format, including conversion to associative arrays with various metadata handling.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts a SugarBean object into a JSON string, with options for pretty printing and hiding empty values.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts a SugarBean into a nested associative array representation.

methods.name: toArrayOld
methods.description: Legacy method for converting a SugarBean into an array, with extensive manual field processing and metadata structuring.

methods.name: fixName
methods.description: Standardizes the name fields of Person or Contact modules to ensure consistent nesting.

methods.name: getFieldsAndKeys
methods.description: Extracts raw data fields and keys from a SugarBean for serialization.
